San Francisco, California · coffee

Coffee in San Francisco for cyclists

Where riders in San Francisco start the day and finish the ride. Open early, near the routes, fine with a table of people in bibs. The ones marked ride-out sit at a group ride's start; the note says which ride and when.

Coffee in San Francisco for cyclists, listed

  1. Equator Coffees at Proof Lab

    244 Shoreline Hwy, Mill Valley, CA 94941 · 6:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily

    ride-out

    Zone 2, Mill Valley, on Highway 1 on the Marin side of the bridge. Tam Velo Club's Saturday ride (Saturdays, 8:30 am) and its Sunday ride (Sundays, 9:30 am) leave from here, per the club's 2026 page. Equator calls it a regular stop for cyclists, with patios front and back; nothing on any page says bike parking. Hours are from a listing updated April 2026.

    The ride from here: Tam Velo Club Saturday Ride (Saturdays, 8:30 am); Tam Velo Club Sunday Recovery Ride (Sundays, 9:30 am) →

  2. Arsicault Bakery

    397 Arguello Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94118 · 7 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. weekdays, 8 to 2 Saturday, 8 to 3 Sunday

    ride-out

    Zone 1 meets Zone 3: on Arguello at Clement in the Inner Richmond, just south of the Presidio. Where Fat Cake Club's Headlands ride (Tuesdays, 6:30 am) ends: over the bridge, up Hawk Hill, back through the Presidio to here, per the club. Expect a line out the door. No site of its own; the hours are from a map listing that isn't dated, so they're a guide, not a promise. Nothing on any page says bike parking.

  3. Peet's Coffee, Domingo

    2916 Domingo Ave, Berkeley, CA 94705 · 5:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. weekdays, 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. weekends

    ride-out

    Zone 5, the East Bay: the Claremont corner of Berkeley, next to the Claremont Hotel. Berkeley Bicycle Club's Coffee Ride (Fridays, 6:45 am) and its WTFN ride (2nd Sunday of the month, 8:30 am) meet here. The early one: 5:30 a.m. on weekdays, 6 on weekends, with benches outside, per Peet's. No bike parking on the page.

    The ride from here: Berkeley Bicycle Club Friday Coffee Ride (Fridays, 6:45 am); Berkeley Bicycle Club Sunday WTFN Ride (2nd Sunday of the month, 8:30 am) →

  4. Bovine Bakery

    11315 Highway 1, Point Reyes Station, CA 94956 · 6:30 a.m. weekdays, 7 a.m. weekends; closes at 4 or 5 p.m. (listings differ)

    Zone 2, the long day: a bakery on Highway 1 in Point Reyes Station, the turnaround of the Point Reyes route and the town Marin Cyclists' ride from Fairfax (Saturdays, 8:45 am) rides out to. Opens at 6:30 on weekdays. Two listings agree on the hours and the phone, but neither was dated this year, so call (415) 663-9420 before you plan the day around it.

  5. Java Beach Cafe

    1396 La Playa Street, San Francisco, CA 94122 · 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily

    Zone 3, the ocean side: in the Outer Sunset, across the Great Highway from Ocean Beach, per its site, at the Sunset Dunes end of a Golden Gate Park loop. Opens at 7, so it's the coffee after a dawn loop of the park and the coast, not before. A second shop, Java Beach at the Zoo on Sloat Blvd, opens at 7 too, per the same page. Nothing on its page says bike parking.
